rows.Kwic: 達祖單傳，不存知解，滹沱棒喝，盡斬葛藤，縱云一物全無，業已和盤托出。

Override.AttributionNote: 笑堂和尚語錄, preface by Chen Zhishen. Chen Zhishen is the exact author: the preface closes with his signature 陳之伸頓首拜撰, and the stored appraisal says the Linji staff and shout cut through all entangling vines.
